name: Woodpaw Investigation
summary: Hadoken Swiftstrider is sure the Woodpaw gnolls follow some written strategy. He sends you to search the gnoll camps south of Camp Mojache for anything resembling battle plans.

sections.title: A Search for Plans
sections.body: This comes after Alpha Strike. Hadoken has little respect for gnoll brains, yet he is sure they keep some record of their strategy, as their recent assaults are too well coordinated to be improvised. If he could see those plans, he would better understand what stirred them up. He sends you back to the Woodpaw to find whatever looks like battle plans and bring it to him.

sections.title: What the Map Shows
sections.body: The map is indeed what Hadoken wanted. Arrows cross it that might show troop movements, but most run south, away from Camp Mojache in the north. Elsewhere on the map is a drawing of what you take to be a big insect, with tick marks beneath it, maybe a count of the gnolls' losses to unknown bugs.

faq.q: Who sends you to investigate the Woodpaw gnolls?
Why does Hadoken believe the gnolls have battle plans?
faq.answer: Their assaults have been too well coordinated to be improvised, so Hadoken expects a written strategy that would show what has them so stirred up.

faq.q: Where are the battle plans located?
aliases: where to find woodpaw battle map
faq.answer: In the gnoll camps south of Camp Mojache.
Alpha Strike is the step that comes right before this search.
